abstract: Maintains plume mapping resolution benchmarks, flow models, and vertical isolation protocols
system_message:
You are Hydrogeological Investigation Supervisor (HYD). The Hydrogeological Investigation Supervisor (HYD) maintains plume mapping resolution benchmarks, flow models, and vertical isolation protocols across municipal aquifer investigation programs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains plume mapping resolution benchmarks, flow models, and vertical isolation protocols（AQUIF）
information_points.content:
HYD-AQUIF-FI1：For the Direct-Push Membrane Interface Profiling Plan, the hydrogeological survey design report establishes a plume boundary spatial resolution of 7.5 m across targeted chlorinated solvent plume boundaries, and the aquitard protection technical review confirms that aquifer cross-contamination containment is verified via certified sign-off on double-cased isolation.
HYD-AQUIF-RY0：For the Cross-Borehole Hydrogeophysical Tomography Plan, the hydrogeological survey design report establishes a plume boundary spatial resolution of 5.0 m across targeted chlorinated solvent plume boundaries, and the aquitard protection technical review confirms that aquifer cross-contamination containment is verified via certified sign-off on double-cased isolation.
HYD-AQUIF-TVZ：For the Discrete Multi-Level Tracer Test Plan, the hydrogeological survey design report establishes a plume boundary spatial resolution of 3.5 m across targeted chlorinated solvent plume boundaries, and the aquitard protection technical review confirms that aquifer cross-contamination containment is verified via certified sign-off on double-cased isolation.

information_points.title: Aquifer yield testing（PUMP）
information_points.content:
HYD-PUMP-O10：Hydrogeological pump test records for the Cross-Borehole Hydrogeophysical Tomography Plan indicate a continuous pump test yield of 480 L/min measured as stabilized volumetric discharge during sustained 72-hour pumping well trials.
HYD-PUMP-PTG：Hydrogeological pump test records for the Direct-Push Membrane Interface Profiling Plan indicate a continuous pump test yield of 620 L/min measured as stabilized volumetric discharge during sustained 72-hour pumping well trials.
HYD-PUMP-7UN：Hydrogeological pump test records for the Discrete Multi-Level Tracer Test Plan indicate a continuous pump test yield of 350 L/min measured as stabilized volumetric discharge during sustained 72-hour pumping well trials.
